title: Appointment of Judges and Additional Judges in Chhattisgarh High Court and Gauhati High Court
body_text:
In exercise of the powers conferred by the Constitution of India, in consultation with Chief Justice of India, the President is pleased to appoint the following Advocate/Judicial Officers as Judges / Additional Judges in the High Courts:-
S. No. Name of the recommendee (S/Shri) Details Santosh Sharma, Judicial Officer Appointed as Judges of Chhattisgarh High Court Smt. Sushma Sawant, Judicial Officer Sudhir Kumar, Judicial Officer Nchumbemo Mozhui, Advocate Appointed as Additional Judges of Gauhati High Court Smt. Helen Dawngliani, Judicial Officer
***
SB/SK
